title: BITHABIT connect file
description: Lives in each app repo (.bithabit/connect.yaml). Maps design-system components to the app's own components so ds-sync can suggest updates. The design system never reads app code at runtime and the app never depends on the design system at runtime.

designSystem.description: npm name of the design-system package.

globalCss.description: Path of the CSS file that defines the --color-* variables.

component.description: Path of the app component file, relative to the app root.

export.description: Exported name in that file. Use either export or variants.

syncedVersion.description: Spec version the app component was last aligned with.

syncedHash.description: contentHash from the manifest at that time; detects spec edits that forgot a version bump.

props.description: Design-system prop name -> the app's prop name, or null when the app does not have it.

acceptedGaps.description: Differences from the contract the team decided to keep. They stop being reported.

variants.description: For a design-system component that the app implements as several components (for example Button as ButtonPrimary, ButtonOutline...): design-system variant name -> the app's export.

propsType.description: Name of the props type when it cannot be inferred from the component signature.

ignore.description: Design-system components the app intentionally does not use.
